svg.title: Ishikari metro map, readable
svg.text: Read it like a page: each row left to right, then wrap to the next row.
a plan may run a saved workflow in place of a worker ant
bugs: the detective's fix plan goes back to the worker;
the worker builds it, the detective re-checks; 3 tries per bug
fail: tasks clash: the task takes
them in, then the fix loop; 2 rounds
7+, or no gaps: no fix round
below 7 and gaps: one fix round
a failed fix keeps its branch;
one live agent run by the skill: reads
the repo once, gets each answer as a message;
no Agent tool: the plan workflow runs it
8 in all; answering approves the whole run
up to 5 at once, web + computer,
the main session pipes it into ishikari.py req add
one per task: title, files, after;
logbook clerk ant: appends each ant's entry
the moment the ant replies, one clerk at a time, in plan, build and finish.
The live investigator gets only an investigated entry.
Build and finish add a summary at the end. No ant reads it.
one per built task: checks it against plan +
design, runs tests (reuses the worker's if clean);
finds each bug's cause and plans its fix
merges passing tasks in a scratch
copy, tests once: the combined test;
fewer than 2 passing tasks: no combined test
after 3 tries on a bug or
merges in a straight line in a scratch copy,
or reuses build's trial merge; then checks
its own merge with git cherry
a conflict, failed tests, or a task
git finds missing: next build round;
cleans up dead code and mess itself: edits,
runs the tests, commits, lands it only if
they pass. Skipped under 100 changed lines;
a cleanup run has no janitor
its note offered as the next Task
one per merged task, 5 at once;
scores the run 0-10: does the code
match the plans? its own call, not an average
checks the fix, runs the tests
fast-forwards the scratch copy to the fix;
the fix lands only through this fast-forward
appends the stage rows, runs the check
the finisher ant builds and checks the app,
only when main moved and checkCommand is set
a failed check: one build round
the main session marks the kept :ID:s
once the check passed, or there is none
a bug through the fix loop
